current_example.title: Example: Raising a Number to the Power of One

q-1985.name: Question 1
q-1985.worked_solution:
The number $3$ is multiplied by itself $5$ times, so we have

$$
{{3\times 3\times 3\times 3\times 3}_{⏟}}_{5\text{ copies of }3}={3}^{5}.
$$

Therefore, the answer is ${3}^{5}.$

q-75533.name: Question 2
q-75533.worked_solution:
The number $(-\frac{3}{8})$ is multiplied by itself $4$ times, so we have

$$
{{(-\frac{3}{8})\times (-\frac{3}{8})\times (-\frac{3}{8})\times (-\frac{3}{8})}_{⏟}}_{4\text{ copies of }(-\frac{3}{8})}={(-\frac{3}{8})}^{4}.
$$

Therefore, the answer is ${(-\frac{3}{8})}^{4}.$

\begin{aligned}{7}^{4} & =(7\times 7)\times (7\times 7) \\  & =49\times 49 \\  & =2\,401.\end{aligned}
$$
